summary: @thalidanoel You have always been a thought leader. Any chance of adding webmentions to Etsy? Bs cool to encourage artists to blog about work on their own domain while hosting products on users. Plus they can see who talks about their products.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@thalidanoel You have always been a thought leader. Any chance of adding webmentions to Etsy?

Bs cool to encourage artists to blog about work on their own domain while hosting products on users.

Plus they can see who talks about their products.
